verdict.rationale: Spline's docs show two narrow ways to act on many items at once: edits to a main component propagate to all its instances, and Boolean operations apply to a set of selected 3D objects. Neither is a general bulk-operation capability across arbitrary items, and no AI-native or API batch mechanism is documented. Missing for 10: general multi-select bulk editing of arbitrary objects, batch operations via the AI Agent, MCP or API, cross-file bulk actions, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: whenever there are changes made to the main component all instances will update accordingly
There are 3 different Boolean Operations that you can apply to a set of selected 3D objects
